translation: (See under the Yin Qiao below.) From Jingming it ascends entering the hairline, descends behind the ear, and, entering Fengchi, ends there. (Fengchi is behind the ear, in the depression in the hairline flanking the Yuzhen bone below.) In all there are twenty-two points. The Nanjing says: The Qiao vessel from the foot to the eye is seven chi five cun long; joined [with its mate] it makes one zhang five chi.
